column1: # Source surface → docs that describe it. One source of truth, read by the docs-sync skill and by
#   2. space-separated docs pages: a published page relative to apps/docs/src/content/ (".mdx"
#      implied), a maintainer page under docs/ (unpublished, but embedded for the MCP docs tools),
#      or a repo path for a non-page file that mirrors the source
#   3. "gen" when a published reference page renders from this source at build time (rebuild, then
#      check the prose around it), else "prose"
# Keep rows narrow: a row that matches everything nags on every edit and gets ignored.
# .claude/scripts/toolkit-check.sh fails when a regex matches no file or a page doesn't exist.

column2: guides/media guides/share-links guides/delivering-assets docs/architecture.md docs/domain-model.md docs/api-reference.md
